svg.title: Three ARP frames, three flow identities
svg.desc: The request, broadcast from 00:16:ce:6e:8b:24 asking for 192.168.0.1, its reply, sent back unicast from 00:13:46:0b:22:ba, and a gratuitous ARP whose sender and target protocol addresses are the same host. Each is a PacketFlow with a data link and an internet layer, and nothing above: the reply has the source and destination of the request swapped.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
